decision.comment: HH_260906 - Compare matched low-speed motion histories with and without tail service braking; preserve all raw samples and prior experiments.

decision.camera_anchors: First even native tick at/after firsttail sample; last scheduled even tick<=70+actual launchcount+600+300. No earlier substitute; label any finaloddnative offset.

decision.analysis: ABBA A=coast,B=service. Compare sharedprefix and samearm repeats. Measure300tail intervals from coast600 sourcepose through finaltail; separately last10s signedvelocity even/odd parity, actualpose displacement and signedvectorvelocity integral with explicit time support. No scalar speed integral substitution.
decision.interpretation: Controlled brake intervention after a shared motion history in one fixed CARLA setup. Descriptive repeatability and response only; not internal substep/wheel/stiction/COM cause proof, physical actuator timing, stopping comfort, fullroute30kph or general standing approval.
decision.unchanged: No hidden extra ticks, pose/velocity injection, physicsdisable, label/gate/model/TF edits, TEST access, training admission, automaticwinner or remote/GPU1 work.
